CHARS.name: Captain (Gran / Djeeta)
CHARS.mechanic: Adept Arts increases when you land combo finishers; higher Arts levels empower skills.
CHARS.rotation: Build Arts with finishers → apply Armor Break → spend an empowered attack skill → rebuild Arts before its duration expires.
tips: Swap Clarity for Phalanx, Substitute, Veil or a heal when your party needs protection.
Power Raise is a useful alternate for a charge-focused Master Trait path.
Strong as AI utility; prioritize debuffs and party survival over theoretical solo DPS.
CHARS.special: Exact optimal unique-Sigil pair depends on whether you choose damage, healing, or Substitute specialization.

CHARS.name: Katalina
CHARS.mechanic: Combo finishers fill the Ares gauge; with Ares summoned, skills and party protection become stronger.
CHARS.rotation: Use Azure Sword for quick gauge → summon Ares → chain Pactstrike sequences and skills → avoid dropping Ares during boss transitions.
tips: Light Wall becomes valuable party protection while Ares is out; replace one damage skill when necessary.
Don’t use every skill before summoning Ares; the enhanced versions are the payoff.
Support your team while keeping attack uptime through safe Pactstrike strings.
CHARS.priority: Quick Cooldown + Cascade for Ares uptime

CHARS.name: Rackam
CHARS.mechanic: Repeated fire builds Heat, reducing the charge time of Bull’s Eye Blast; Rhythmic Trigger rewards controlled bursts.
CHARS.rotation: Build Heat with rhythmically timed bursts → activate your gun buffs at high Heat → charge Bull’s Eye Blast during openings.
tips: Wild Gunsmoke boosts offense but lowers defense; don’t stand still under telegraphed attacks.
Duration offers safety against dangerous patterns.
The early-stage source accidentally listed Sigils as skills; these four names come from the actual skill list and combat description.
CHARS.priority: Combo Booster / Concentrated Fire; avoid overinvesting in charged skills when AI-controlled
CHARS.special: AI and manual-aim variants require different skill choices; treat this as an active-player loadout.

CHARS.name: Io
CHARS.mechanic: Mystic Vortex orbs power up Stargaze; Quick Cast accelerates Stargaze after an orb-producing action.
CHARS.rotation: Place Concentration safely → cast Fire/Lightning for orbs → unleash Stargaze at the appropriate charge → dodge-cancel recovery → repeat.
tips: Quick Charge helps while learning, but Master Traits may later provide enough charge speed.
Maintain position inside Concentration where the chosen Master Traits reward it.
Do not assume more raw attack increases damage once Stargaze is capped.

CHARS.name: Eugen
CHARS.mechanic: Manual aim and grenade placement reward weak-point knowledge; explosive sequences provide substantial damage.
CHARS.rotation: Aim grenades at large hitboxes/weak points → trigger detonations and aim attacks → use paralysis to create safe windows.
tips: Manual-aim and AI builds differ significantly; do not blindly give AI a manual-aim cap setup.
Try Concentrated Fire only when ranged attack damage actually benefits.
Save control skills for boss burst windows or dangerous patterns.
CHARS.priority: Concentrated Fire, Quick Charge, weak-point cap

CHARS.name: Rosetta
CHARS.mechanic: Plant roses and command them to attack or buff the party; positioning matters more than button speed.
CHARS.rotation: Establish roses near the boss → use Spiral Rose for damage → activate Iron Maiden while plants can connect → protect the team as needed.
tips: Reposition roses when a boss moves; unattended plants waste damage.
For AI support, favor Quick Cooldown, Cascade, survivability and party buffs.
You can substitute a healing or defense skill for more difficult encounters.

CHARS.name: Charlotta
CHARS.mechanic: Short, fast sword combos feed Noble Stance and rapid attacks; some finishers can be extended.
CHARS.rotation: Use your attack buff → maintain Noble Stance through short, uninterrupted strings → use gap closers to stay glued to the target.
tips: Combo Booster works best if you can maintain uninterrupted hits.
Her parry/invincibility tools can avoid dangerous mechanics.
Learn when to stop attacking rather than losing a long streak to knockback.
CHARS.priority: Combo Booster / Normal Attack DMG Cap

CHARS.name: Ghandagoza
CHARS.mechanic: Perfectly timed attacks build Eternal Rage, which converts into enormous Raging Fist damage.
CHARS.rotation: Build Rage through timed strings → wait for a reliable damage window → land high-power Raging Fist → repeat; exploit Link Time.
tips: Raging Fist can be slow; Quick Charge is a comfort option, not necessarily permanent BiS.
Avoid using the strongest punch against a target that will move away.
Prioritize the level of Rage and charge efficiency over animation-spam.

CHARS.name: Ferry
CHARS.mechanic: Summon pets and coordinate their hits with Onslaught or aerial attacks; hit frequency assists SBA gain.
CHARS.rotation: Summon pets → apply uptime buffs → weave Onslaught and aerial attacks during pet windows → resummon when necessary.
tips: The source describes a strong aerial-barrage variant; practice it before building purely for paper DPS.
Quick Cooldown and Cascade support pet and debuff uptime.
An AI Ferry can take a more supportive skill spread than your manual build.

CHARS.name: Narmaya
CHARS.mechanic: Dawnfly and Freeflutter stances interact with butterfly stacks; butterfly-boosted Setsuna is a major burst option.
CHARS.rotation: Generate butterflies in Freeflutter → stance-shift at the proper cue → spend at high stack count on Setsuna → dodge-cancel recovery.
tips: Practice stance shifts before optimizing damage Sigils.
Dance of Pink Petals helps with uninterrupted charged sequences.
Add Quick Charge for a Setsuna-centered version; replace with combo utility if charging is already fast.

CHARS.name: Lancelot
CHARS.mechanic: Rapid dagger hits combine with a distinctive evasive attack; dodging can preserve pressure.
CHARS.rotation: Close distance → attack constantly → use Twin Blade Dance to dodge boss patterns while remaining close → exploit safe skill windows.
tips: Improved Dodge and Nimble Onslaught are especially comfortable here.
Dodge Payback may help a practiced perfect-dodge player.
Do not build entirely around no-damage assumptions before learning boss tells.

CHARS.name: Vane
CHARS.mechanic: Heavy attacks and skills build Beatdown; Rampart provides valuable group protection.
CHARS.rotation: Use Heavy Swing blocks and fast skills to enter combo finishers; fill Beatdown Gauge, then spend a full gauge on Beatdown combo and finisher. During Link Time, use link-attack/dodge-cancel skips to reach the strongest hits.
tips: Updated Sept 27 (Rets): Heroic Beat + Arm Destruction are recommended low-cooldown skills. Drachenstolz is recommended; Breakthrough is optional, not a fixed fourth choice.
Swap one damage skill for Rampart when a fight calls for full-party invulnerability.
Steel Nerves, Stout Heart, and mitigation make more sense for Vane than pure glass-cannon Sigils.
If playing AI tank, favor consistent guard and party utility.

Hero's Will can accelerate cooldowns through the combo loop; Cascade and Quick Cooldown are optional, not automatic best-in-slot. Prioritize blocking uptime and the Crux: Resolve plan if following the detailed guide.

CHARS.name: Percival
CHARS.mechanic: Using skills prepares faster Schlacht charges, enabling powerful repeated burst attacks.
CHARS.rotation: Activate Träumerei → skill → charge Schlacht immediately → another skill → Schlacht again → repeat until cooldowns.
tips: The skill-to-charged-attack transition matters more than mashing normal attacks.
Quick Charge is convenient but can be reduced when your rotation already fast-charges.
Coordinate Schlacht with break, paralysis, or stun windows.

CHARS.name: Siegfried
CHARS.mechanic: A precise attack rhythm improves each strike and combo finisher; some tools offer defense while executing.
CHARS.rotation: Maintain the perfect-input rhythm → weave mobility skill if the target moves → finish the timed combo → reposition.
tips: Practice the cadence on Sir Barrold before farming the perfect Sigils.
You can dodge between precision attacks without losing the whole sequence.
Combo Finisher DMG helps when that part of your string is damage-capped.

CHARS.name: Cagliostro
CHARS.mechanic: Combo finishers accelerate Collapse; she can mix strong burst with buffs and healing.
CHARS.rotation: Use short skills → complete a finisher → fast-charge Collapse → reposition → reapply party damage buffs as needed.
tips: Phantasmagoria is a key party damage buff.
For a dedicated healer, use Reinforce over an offensive option.
Quick Cooldown, Cascade and skill cap matter more for burst variants.

CHARS.name: Yodarha
CHARS.mechanic: Consecutive strings become faster; Triple Shroud marks improve skill effects and defense.
CHARS.rotation: Chain multiple normal combos to shorten them → keep Triple Shroud marks → spend skills at three marks → repeat.
tips: Perpetual Rotation quickly supplies Triple Shroud marks.
Hymn of the Hundreds can help survive a dangerous boss move.
Nimble Onslaught improves aggressive positioning for a melee specialist.

CHARS.name: Zeta
CHARS.mechanic: Spear loops and Arvess Fermare debuff reward sustained air combos and correct landing timing.
CHARS.rotation: Apply Arvess Fermare → launch airborne attack strings → land aerial follow-ups at the correct timing → use abilities during openings.
tips: Warpath can change effective critical chance; recalculate before wasting a Critical Hit Rate slot.
Stout Heart may be helpful while learning aerial attacks.
Keep the boss marked so your party also benefits from the debuff.

CHARS.name: Vaseraga
CHARS.mechanic: Immortal Pain grants Undying while reducing current HP, enabling a risky but very powerful charged-scythe playstyle.
CHARS.rotation: Raise Grynoth → activate Immortal Pain before a safe damage window → hit charged heavy strikes → retreat before Undying wears off.
tips: Core signature priority: Ebony's Poise for skill cooldown on charged finisher hits; Ebony's Warpath for damage. Immortal Pain uptime depends on continuing to land charged attacks.
Do not confuse maximum HP with current HP: Defender Ecru uses max HP, whereas Enmity cares about current HP.
Avoid healing away your low-HP buff unless survival requires it.
Celestial Nyx and Enmity are situational later options; not automatic generalist picks.
At Chaos++, Celestial Nyx is a low-current-HP option; high maximum HP for Defender Ecru is compatible with low current HP. Celestial Lumen is a poor fit for this rotation.
CHARS.special: One optional skill is a flexible slot; verify Battalions of Fear in your current skill list before committing.

CHARS.name: Beatrix
CHARS.mechanic: Delta Clock timing and Devour Causality convert well-timed actions into damaging combo finishers.
CHARS.rotation: Fill Embrasque / set the Delta Clock → hit the ideal timing window → chain normal attacks and finisher follow-ups → exploit your buff.
tips: Practice the Delta Clock timing before chasing low-HP damage extremes.
Her Warpath changes damage taken; don’t assume it is free damage.
Skill use can shorten the path to another combo finisher.
For a specialized high-DPS alternative, consult the July 30 Essence Beatrix community guide. That loadout prioritizes different Master Trait choices from a generic Defender template.
CHARS.priority: Combo Finisher DMG / cooldowns; optional Enmity

CHARS.name: Eustace
CHARS.mechanic: Timed reloading creates Heavy Ammo; higher-grade shots benefit from accurate pacing.
CHARS.rotation: Land normal shots → reload at the correct cue / after link attacks → use Heavy Ammo on grade III–IV shots → repeat.
tips: Reload proactively; don’t wait until your ammo has completely run out.
Acuity improves higher-grade shot cap, so generic cap may be less valuable later.
The source includes Flamek Thunder both as a weapon name and in its recommended skills; cross-check your skill menu if absent.

CHARS.name: Id
CHARS.mechanic: Normal form fills Versalis; Dragonform builds toward Godmight for enhanced attacks.
CHARS.rotation: Attack with finishers to fill Versalis → activate Dragonform → build segments to Godmight → spend strong attacks and repeat.
tips: Don’t expend your best skill just before a transformation that upgrades it.
Character Sigils supporting Versalis or Godmight can outperform generic attack traits.
Plan boss transition timing so your transformation is not wasted.

CHARS.name: Sandalphon
CHARS.mechanic: Build Archangel resources, then enter Supreme Primarch Mode and use its enhanced attack patterns.
CHARS.rotation: Accumulate gauge → switch to Supreme Primarch Mode → keep pressure with Lightstep sword-wave attacks → use skills within the mode window.
tips: Ain sets a 45,000 max-HP cap and conflicts with high-HP Defender Ecru goals; do not equip it on the Defender template.
Use Supreme Primarch’s Warpath if its mode interaction suits your loop.
For Sandalphon, the usual two-character-Sigil template has an important exception.
Ain+ is a separate weapon/HP plan: do not assume the Defender Ecru HP thresholds carry over unchanged to Ain+.
CHARS.special: Ain+ is a separate low-max-HP build and should replace the universal high-HP assumptions, not stack with them.

CHARS.name: Seofon
CHARS.mechanic: An avatar fights alongside Seofon; Swordshine/Avatar gauge resources enhance finishers and skills.
CHARS.rotation: Build Avatar gauge → summon avatar → use your high-value skills while avatar is active → use Tempesta to refill → land combined finishers.
tips: Avoid blowing skills outside an avatar window without a specific reason.
Cascade can accelerate the next avatar setup.
Character Awakening and Warpath effects reward avatar teamwork more than generic raw ATK.

CHARS.name: Tweyen
CHARS.mechanic: Ultrasight stacks empower Multilock Hail; perfectly timed, charged shots are the central damage pattern.
CHARS.rotation: Build Ultrasight with charged combo finishers → release full Multilock Hail → dodge only after arrows launch → use Lethal Rain and Wheel of Death between attacks. With Crux, prepare and fire Two-Crown’s Strife after building its stacks.
tips: Combo C (xxxyy) is the reliable default; charge the finisher for greater damage and Ultrasight gain.
Combo B can win against large or close targets when enough arrows actually connect; otherwise favor Combo C.
Two-Crown’s Strife is a committed one-use cast. Do not cast SBA immediately afterward, because it can consume some arrows.
CHARS.priority: Quick Charge for Multilock Hail lock-on speed; improve cap and utility while preserving Warpath/Volley.

CHARS.name: Fraux
CHARS.mechanic: Delayed flip kicks and stance changes charge resources, then convert them into stronger skills.
CHARS.rotation: Build resources with the correctly timed flip kick → shift stance → spend empowered abilities → reset through finishers.
tips: Learn delayed timing; a normal kick is not equivalent to a delayed one.
Skilled Assault and cooldown reduction suit skill-heavy rotations.
Character Awakening improves gauge gain and can matter more than raw attack.

CHARS.name: Fediel
CHARS.mechanic: Alternates ranged casting and close-range stomp chains; Voidskip/Blackflash enable mobility and follow-ups.
CHARS.rotation: For Insight, build Enhanced Combo Finishers to Lv. 5 while cycling empowered attacks; do not rely on pre-2.0.5 low-stack orb spam. For Essence/Crux, follow the chosen Master Style rather than copying the Insight rotation.
tips: Patch 2.0.5: Insight: Finishing Touch Enhanced Combo Finishers now caps at level 5 (previously 10). Unenhanced magic-orb damage was reduced, while higher stacks gained damage; build stacks rather than abusing low-stack spam.
Claws of Reversal can counter a dangerous attack.
A defense-debuffing stomp improves party damage.
Don’t force melee against a boss when ranged attacks are the safe choice.
CHARS.priority: Combo Booster / Quick Cooldown / stomp uptime

CHARS.name: Gallanza
CHARS.mechanic: Perfect attack timing powers up his spear Turbine; Deathmatch Finale strengthens key sequences.
CHARS.rotation: Keep the Turbine rhythm → pop Deathmatch Finale before a suitable opening → cash out Turbine++ → guard/counter when boss attacks.
tips: Patch 2.0.5 fixed an unintended SBA activation below full gauge when entering Deathmatch Finale / max Wild Showman; do not plan a rotation around that exploit.
Stout Heart prevents interruption during committed sequences.
Warpath and Frenzy are his unique pair, rather than blindly assuming Awakening+.
Check whether Combo Booster has uninterrupted hit uptime against the target.
CHARS.priority: Stout Heart / Steel Nerves / Combo Booster

CHARS.name: Maglielle
CHARS.mechanic: Build Veil gauge, perform timely Blade Dance finishers and command floating swords for damage and utility.
CHARS.rotation: Land enhanced combo finishers (prefer XXXY for stable targets, XY for mobile targets) → build Veil Gauge → unleash Blade Dance IV at full gauge → release at the refund timing → repeat. A link attack can enable immediate BD4.
tips: CF3 (XXXY) is the main enhanced finisher; CF1 (XY) builds gauge quickly against mobile targets. CF2 is less effective in most solo encounters.
Pistol of Demons supplies strong persistent skill damage; Spear of Legends gives DEF↓; Sostenuto supports shield-based Crux.
Only two summoned weapons can exist simultaneously; a third replaces the first and can refund some cooldown.
CHARS.priority: Cascade for Pistol uptime, Warpath and Circuit for Blade Dance; choose shield support if using Crux.
